monitoring.beacons.err_choose_hub: Several Hubs are online. Pick the one that should register this Beacon.

monitoring.beacons.err_client_hub: Beacons are registered on the Server {server} only; Client {client} does not take registrations.
monitoring.beacons.err_invalid_mac: MAC address must be in AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF format.
monitoring.beacons.err_read_only: The beacon is read-only and refuses configuration writes.
monitoring.beacons.err_remove_confirm_mi: That is not this Beacon's MAC. Nothing was removed.
monitoring.beacons.err_remove_failed: The Beacon could not be removed.
monitoring.beacons.err_serial_required: The serial number is required — copy it from the device's label.
monitoring.beacons.err_unknown_beacon: That Beacon is not registered — it may have just been removed.
monitoring.beacons.no_device_body: No Hub has reported in yet, so there are no Beacons to show.

monitoring.beacons.removed_reappears_not: Removing a Beacon first asks the Hub to rewrite its configuration and then deletes the registration. The Beacon keeps broadcasting, so it reappears among the discovered ones — that is expected, not a failure.
monitoring.beacons.scan_capped: The Hub is hearing more beacons than it can report, so this list is incomplete — some neighbours are being dropped.
monitoring.beacons.scan_empty: Nothing overheard in the last {minutes} minutes.

monitoring.bulk.dialog_subtitle: Pick the channels, set the limits once and apply them to all of them.

monitoring.bulk.empty: No channel on this Hub can take limits yet.

monitoring.bulk.err_no_fields: Tick at least one of temperature and humidity.
monitoring.bulk.skipped_no_field: Nothing this sensor measures was selected.
monitoring.bulk.write_paths_note: Wired probes and Beacons take effect as soon as the Hub answers. A Node keeps the limits as a draft until you send it from the Node's page.

monitoring.calibration.err_delete_not_fo: The certificate was not found, or it is deleted already.

monitoring.calibration.probes_intro: A calibration belongs to the Hub's line, not to the probe itself: after replacing a probe upload its certificate, after moving it to another line or Hub upload it there.
monitoring.calibration.upload_replaces: A new calibration replaces the current one, which moves to the history.
monitoring.diag.no_hex: The stored message carries no raw bytes.
monitoring.limits.sending_note: The Nodes got the new limits; they take effect once each device accepts them on its next uplink. The State column shows the progress.
monitoring.limits.foreign_draft: This Node's draft holds other changes too, so nothing was sent. Open it and send its configuration.
monitoring.limits.search: Search for a sensor or channel…
monitoring.limits.one_hub: The selected channels are on several Hubs. The panel sets limits on one Hub; select channels of one of them.
monitoring.limits.select_section: Select every channel in this section
monitoring.limits.other_quantity: A different quantity or unit than the selected channels
monitoring.limits_editor.sending: Saved and sent to the Node.
monitoring.command_error.device_busy: The Node is still handling an earlier command. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
monitoring.command_error.address_collisi: Cannot add the node as a P2P node: its radio address (the last 8 hex digits of the DevEUI) is already used by another node on this Hub. P2P nodes are addressed on air by the last 32 bits of the DevEUI only, so two nodes with the same ending cannot share a Hub. Use LoRaWAN for one of them or move it to another Hub.
monitoring.command_error.mqtt_unavailabl: The portal could not reach the MQTT broker, so the command was not sent. Check the portal's connection and try again.
monitoring.command_error.no_answer: The device did not answer in time. Check that the Hub is on and connected, then try again.
monitoring.command_error.node_unknown: The radio network does not know this Node. Check that the Node has been added on this Hub.
monitoring.command_error.not_permitted: Your role does not allow this command. Ask an Admin for higher permissions.
monitoring.command_error.radio_not_confi: Radio control is not set up for this portal, so commands to Nodes cannot be sent from here. Send them from the portal on the Hub the Node belongs to, or check the Hub's radio settings.
monitoring.command_error.radio_unavailab: The Hub's radio service is not responding. Try again in a moment. If that does not help, restart the application on the Hub.
monitoring.command_error.rate_limited: This command was sent to this Node moments ago. Wait a while, then try again.
monitoring.command_error.transport_error: The Hub got no answer from the Node, or could not hand it the command. Check that the Node is on and in range, then try again.
monitoring.command_error.undelivered: The Hub could not deliver the command to the Node in 5 attempts and gave it up. Check that the Node is on and in range, then send the command again.
monitoring.command_error.not_sent: The command could not be sent: the network server discarded it because it is too large for the Node's current data rate. The reason is below. Send a smaller command (e.g. fewer keys at once), or wait for a better Node signal.
monitoring.command_error.device_copy_not: Saved in the Portal, which grades alarms with these limits from now on. The device's own copy was not delivered; save again once the device is online to update it.
monitoring.command_accepted.beacon-histo: Accepted by the Hub, download running. Progress shows in the table below.
monitoring.command_accepted.beacon-provi: Accepted by the Hub. The Beacon shows the configuration once the Hub has written and read it back.
monitoring.command_accepted.get_sticker_: Accepted by the Hub, waiting for the Node. Progress shows in the table below.
monitoring.command_accepted.northbridge-: Accepted by the Hub. The Northbridge firmware card shows the progress and the outcome.
monitoring.command_accepted.set_threshol: Saved. The Hub takes the new limits at its next config sync.
monitoring.command_accepted.set_interval: Saved. The Hub takes the new intervals at its next config sync.
monitoring.command_accepted.set_led_brig: Saved. The Hub takes the new LED brightness at its next config sync.
monitoring.command_accepted.set_sample_i: Saved. The Hub takes the new read interval at its next config sync.
monitoring.command_accepted.set_lorawan_: Accepted by the Hub. The new limits apply once the Hub confirms them.
monitoring.command_status.stored: Saved in the Portal, device copy not delivered
monitoring.dashboard.no_device_body: No Hub has reported in yet. For local dev, start the mock publisher — see {readme} ({command}).
monitoring.dashboard.no_probes: This Hub reports no wired probes.
monitoring.dashboard.no_sensors: This Hub reports no probes, Nodes or Beacons.
monitoring.dashboard.search_title: Searches sensor, device and group names
monitoring.device.confirm_hostname_title: Must match the device hostname exactly
monitoring.device.dashboard_subtitle: Live sensor readings and device status
monitoring.device.err_bad_code: Could not decrypt the pairing response — check the pairing code and try again.
monitoring.device.err_invalid_code: Pairing code must be exactly 6 letters or digits.
monitoring.device.err_local_decrypt: Could not decrypt the pairing response from this device. The device software may be too old for code-free local pairing.
monitoring.device.err_mismatch: Pairing aborted: the device's reported key did not match the decrypted key. Nothing was stored.
monitoring.device.err_not_pairing_mode: The device refused pairing because it is not in pairing mode. Open it on the Hub's display: 1) hold the Hub's top button for about 2 s until the menu opens, 2) select “Pairing mode” in the menu and confirm, 3) start pairing in the portal again.
monitoring.device.err_pair_failed: Pairing request failed — check the MQTT connection.
monitoring.device.err_pair_timeout: Pairing timed out waiting for the device to respond.
monitoring.device.err_store_failed: Pairing succeeded but saving the result failed — try again.
monitoring.device.err_unpair_failed: Unpair failed — the device wasn't paired.
monitoring.device.factory_reset_confirm: FACTORY RESET {device} — this permanently erases the device configuration and data and cannot be undone. Continue?
monitoring.device.factory_reset_desc: Returns the device to its factory state. Cannot be undone.
monitoring.device.factory_reset_reason_t: Reason must be at most 256 characters.
Reason must contain at least 8 non-whitespace characters.
monitoring.device.not_paired_title: This Hub is not paired, so the portal cannot send it commands. Pairing is on the System tab.
monitoring.device.unpaired_banner: The Hub {hub} is not paired with this portal, so the portal cannot send it commands: registering Beacons and Nodes and changing limits or Hub settings will fail.
monitoring.device.pair_inline_code_hint: Open pairing mode on the Hub's display, type the code it shows and click Pair device.
monitoring.device.pair_inline_local_hint: Open pairing mode on the Hub's display, then click Pair device.
monitoring.hubs.no_alarm_recipients_aler: Nobody receives this Hub's alarm e-mails: its alarm notifications are off or have no recipients.
monitoring.device.pair_local_hint: This portal runs on this device, so no pairing code is needed. Open the pairing window on the device display, then pair.
monitoring.device.paired_via_invite_line: Paired at {at} from the device itself, with no portal user signed in
monitoring.device.pairing_code_hint: code shown on the device display
monitoring.device.power_off_desc: The Hub goes to sleep; it stays reachable from the Portal.
monitoring.device.restart_desc: Restarts the Hub application; the device does not reboot and reconnects on its own.
monitoring.device.unpair_note: Removes keys from this portal only — the device keeps trusting issued certificates.

monitoring.groups.empty_group: This group has no channels the Hub is currently reporting.
monitoring.groups.err_event_bad_time: That is not a valid date and time.

monitoring.groups.err_event_text_too_lon: The event text is too long (240 characters at most).
monitoring.groups.err_field_taken: That channel is already in another group.
monitoring.groups.err_move_failed: That group could not be moved.

monitoring.groups.err_save_failed: The group could not be saved.
monitoring.groups.err_unknown_probe: This sensor is no longer reported by any Hub.
monitoring.groups.export_failed: The export failed (HTTP {status}) and nothing was downloaded. Try again.
monitoring.groups.export_range_invalid: The end must come after the start.
monitoring.groups.export_range_too_wide: The range can span at most 366 days.
monitoring.groups.export_unreachable: The export failed: the portal did not answer and nothing was downloaded. Try again.
monitoring.groups.field_count_title: Number of channels (measured quantities) in the group. There is one card per sensor, and a sensor can measure several quantities.
monitoring.groups.picker_empty: No Hub has reported any sensors yet.

monitoring.history.select_from_panel: Select channels in the table below

monitoring.history_switch.label: Keep history and download it automatically
monitoring.history_switch.node_keeps_non: The Node keeps no history, so a download will fail.

monitoring.history_switch.saved_to_draft: Saved. The change is being sent to the Node and waits for its confirmation.
monitoring.history_switch.state_drafted: A change for the Node waits in the draft
monitoring.history_switch.state_unknown: The Node's state is not known yet: no config info has arrived.
monitoring.hubs.device_label_hint: The name shown on the LCD. 1 to 64 characters.
monitoring.hubs.device_label_invalid: The label must be 1 to 64 characters.
monitoring.hubs.display_too_many_sensors: The display holds at most {max} sensors.
monitoring.hubs.display_value_out_of_ran: The value must be a whole number from {min} to {max}.
monitoring.hubs.empty_body: The first Hub shows up here as soon as it reports on the broker.
monitoring.hubs.fault_offline: The Hub has stopped reporting — it is offline.
monitoring.hubs.info_interval_invalid: The interval must be a whole number from 10 to 86400 seconds.
monitoring.hubs.read_interval_invalid: Enter a whole number of seconds from 1 to {max}.
monitoring.hubs.meta_description_placeho: e.g. cabinet by the loading dock

monitoring.hubs.picker_empty: This Hub does not report any sensors yet.

monitoring.hubs.picker_max_reached: At most {n} sensors fit on the display; untick one to pick another.

monitoring.hubs.radio_api_auth_failed: The radio API rejected the login. Gateway data may be stale.
monitoring.hubs.radio_api_unreachable: The radio API is unreachable. Gateway data may be stale.
monitoring.hubs.radio_control_off: Commands to Nodes cannot be sent from this portal: radio control is not set up here.
monitoring.hubs.p2p_modulation_readonly: Read-only. No other modulation is supported yet.
monitoring.hubs.gateway_not_local: External gateways are registered on the Portal's own Hub only.
monitoring.hubs.gateway_invalid_eui: The gateway EUI is 16 hex digits.
monitoring.hubs.move_nodes_none: No Node is on a radio this Hub has switched off. Nothing was sent.
monitoring.hubs.move_nodes_result: Moved to {to}: {moved} of {total} Nodes. Switch the Nodes themselves too (NFC or shell radio-mode), or they will not reach the Hub.
monitoring.hubs.move_nodes_stale: The Hub's radio changed meanwhile. Reload the page. Nothing was sent.
monitoring.hubs.move_nodes_warning: The Hub moves every Node from {from} to {to} ({count}): one signed command and one audit row per Node. The Hub does not switch the Nodes themselves. Switch each one by NFC or with the shell command radio-mode, or it will not reach the Hub.
monitoring.hubs.nb_update_already_runnin: A Northbridge firmware update is already running.
monitoring.hubs.fw_not_reported: The Hub reports no bundled firmware for this chip.
monitoring.hubs.fw_update_why_running: An update is already in progress.
monitoring.hubs.fw_update_why_nb_not_rep: The Hub does not report the Northbridge firmware: its software predates reporting it without LoRa P2P.
monitoring.hubs.fw_update_why_nb_silent: The Northbridge does not answer the Hub.
monitoring.hubs.fw_update_why_no_image: This Hub's image bundles no firmware to update to.
monitoring.hubs.nb_update_done_ok: The Northbridge firmware is up to date: it runs {version}.
monitoring.hubs.nb_update_done_unconfirm: The Hub did not confirm the update; the Northbridge runs {version}. See the firmware row.
monitoring.hubs.nb_update_force_hint: Flash even when the Northbridge already runs the version in the Hub image, and after three failed attempts.
monitoring.hubs.nb_update_unavailable: This Hub's image carries no Northbridge firmware, or the Hub does not run the P2P radio.
monitoring.hubs.nb_update_warning: The Hub stops the P2P radio, flashes the Northbridge with the firmware in the Hub image and starts the radio again. The P2P radio is off for about a minute: Nodes are not acknowledged meanwhile, and their readings are recovered from their history.
monitoring.hubs.radio_no_rows: The gateway report does not list this Hub's gateway yet.
monitoring.hubs.radio_not_reported: The Hub has not reported its radio state yet.
monitoring.hubs.radio_unavailable: Radio state unavailable: no gateway report has arrived yet.
monitoring.hubs.rak_low_power_alert: The battery is low ({voltage} V), so the LoRaWAN card (RAK5146) has no power and this Hub receives no data from LoRaWAN Nodes until the battery charges above 3.5 V.
monitoring.hubs.screen_timeout_hint: How many idle seconds before the screen goes dark. 0 = always on.
monitoring.hubs.sensor_text_too_long: The text is too long (64 characters at most).
monitoring.hubs.system_settings_note: Facts the Hub reports. An Admin can change the system/info interval.
monitoring.hubs.thresholds_unit_note: Limits in °C. A dot means the limit is unset. Limits live on the device; the row repaints once the device accepts them.
monitoring.hubs.radio_change_confirm_but: Change the radio and restart the services
monitoring.hubs.radio_change_consequence: LoRaWAN and Dual need the RAK5146 card. A Hub without one refuses the change.
monitoring.hubs.radio_change_confirm_hos: To confirm, type the Hub hostname:
monitoring.hubs.radio_change_consequence: Nothing is deleted: the Node registry, the Nodes' caches, their history and the P2P network identity stay.

When the new mode switches off a radio that has Nodes on it, the dialog asks what happens to them: move them to the new radio, remove them, or leave them on the old protocol. The Nodes themselves are switched by NFC or shell.
monitoring.hubs.radio_change_desc: Changes the radio mode in place. The Hub restarts its radio services and the Portal; no factory reset and no new registration are needed.
monitoring.hubs.radio_change_invalid_mod: Unknown radio mode. Choose LoRaWAN, LoRa P2P or Off.
monitoring.hubs.radio_change_nodes_keep: Leave them on the old protocol
monitoring.hubs.radio_change_nodes_keep_: They stay registered and show “radio off on this Hub”. They can still be moved later.
monitoring.hubs.radio_change_nodes_kept: The Nodes on the radio that goes off ({count}) stay registered.
monitoring.hubs.radio_change_nodes_legen: Nodes on the radio the new mode switches off ({from}): {count}
monitoring.hubs.radio_change_nodes_move: Move them to the new radio ({to})
monitoring.hubs.radio_change_nodes_move_: One signed node-move per Node. The Hub does not switch the Nodes themselves: switch each one by NFC or with the shell command radio-mode.
Off runs no radio to move the Nodes to.
The new mode runs no radio to move the Nodes to. Nothing was sent.
monitoring.hubs.radio_change_nodes_order: The Node step runs before the radio change, while the old radio still runs: one signed command and one audit row per Node. If the Hub then refuses the change (for example without the RAK5146 card), Nodes already moved or removed stay that way.
monitoring.hubs.radio_change_nodes_remov: One signed node-remove per Node, as removing it from its page does. To use it again, it has to be registered again.
monitoring.hubs.radio_change_nodes_requi: Choose what happens to the Nodes on the radio the new mode switches off. Nothing was sent.
monitoring.hubs.radio_change_nodes_switc: The Hub's radio did not change, but the Node step already ran. “Move all Nodes” brings moved Nodes back.
monitoring.hubs.radio_change_reason_too_: The reason can be at most 256 characters.
monitoring.hubs.radio_change_server_only: The radio is changed on the Server the Portal runs on. A client Hub takes the cluster's radio from the Server.
monitoring.hubs.radio_change_unchanged: The Hub already runs this radio mode.
monitoring.hubs.radio_change_warning: The radio services and the Portal restart. The Portal is briefly unavailable, and Nodes on the radio that goes off are no longer heard.
monitoring.hubs.transport_consequence_cl: Client Hubs lose their broker accounts and gateway registrations; the cluster is rebuilt.
monitoring.hubs.transport_consequence_mo: The portal does not pick the target mode. You choose it at provisioning after the reset.
monitoring.hubs.transport_consequence_re: The device registry is wiped: every Node and Beacon must be registered again.
monitoring.hubs.transport_consequence_un: The unit returns to the unprovisioned state and loses its role and configuration.
monitoring.hubs.transport_desc: The transport does not switch in place. The unit goes through a factory reset and the new mode is chosen at re-provisioning (mobile app), outside the portal.
monitoring.hubs.transport_warning: This is a factory reset of the whole unit. It cannot be undone.
monitoring.hubs.unit_viewer_note: A Manager or Admin can change the unit settings.
monitoring.hubs.add_hub_intro: Registers a Client Hub with this Server: the Server creates the Client's broker account and, for LoRaWAN, registers its gateway. You then carry the join bundle to the Client with the {mobile_app} mobile app.
monitoring.hubs.add_hub_hostname_hint: {hostname_prefix} and eight hex digits, as on the Client's display.
monitoring.hubs.add_hub_once_note: The password for the Client is shown once, on the next screen. Running Add hub again for the same Client issues a new one and the old one stops working.
monitoring.hubs.add_hub_not_server: Clients are added on the Server: the Hub this portal runs on.
monitoring.hubs.add_hub_radio_off: This Hub's radio is off, so it cannot take a Client. Change the radio on the System tab first.
monitoring.hubs.add_hub_no_ca: This Hub has no CA certificate (/data/tls/ca.crt), so it cannot issue a join bundle. It is created at boot; restart the Hub or contact service.
monitoring.hubs.add_hub_unpaired: Pair this Hub with the portal first (System tab): adding a Client is a signed command.
monitoring.hubs.add_hub_err_hostname: Enter {hostname_prefix} followed by eight hex digits.
monitoring.hubs.add_hub_err_hostname_ser: That is this Server's own hostname.
monitoring.hubs.add_hub_err_hostname_tak: This Client is already registered. Use Retry on its row to issue a new password.
monitoring.hubs.add_hub_err_eui_server: That is this Server's own gateway EUI.
monitoring.hubs.add_hub_err_eui_taken: This gateway EUI is already registered to another Client.
monitoring.hubs.add_hub_err_name: At most 64 characters, no control characters.
monitoring.hubs.add_hub_err_store: The registry could not be written. Nothing was sent to the Server.
monitoring.hubs.add_hub_err_removed: This Client was removed from the cluster while it was being registered. No join bundle was issued; add it again if it should join.
monitoring.hubs.bundle_gateway_ok: Its broker account is created and its gateway is registered.
monitoring.hubs.bundle_gateway_skipped: Its broker account is created. No gateway was registered: none was given, or this Server runs no LoRaWAN.
monitoring.hubs.bundle_instructions: Set it on the Client: in the {mobile_app} mobile app, connect to {client} and scan this QR code (or paste the text). The Client checks this Server's certificate, joins and restarts.
monitoring.hubs.bundle_once: The password is held only in this Server's memory, for 5 minutes, and can be shown once. After that, or when you close this window, it is gone; Retry then issues a new one.
monitoring.hubs.bundle_rotated: This is a new password: the previous one for this Client no longer works.
monitoring.hubs.bundle_revealed_note: Shown, once, and recorded in the audit log. This window holds the only copy: when you close it the password is gone, and Retry issues a new one.
monitoring.hubs.bundle_reveal_hint: The join bundle contains the password. Show it when the phone is ready to scan; it can be shown only once.
monitoring.hubs.bundle_gone_title: The password is no longer available.
monitoring.hubs.bundle_gone_body: It was already shown, more than 5 minutes have passed, or a Retry replaced it. It is not stored anywhere, so it cannot be shown again.
monitoring.hubs.bundle_gone_other_sessio: It was issued to another session, so it has been discarded.
monitoring.hubs.bundle_gone_retry: Retry issues a new password and a new join bundle. The Client's current password stops working.
monitoring.hubs.registration_incomplete_: Nothing is half done silently: the Client stays marked incomplete until Retry succeeds. Retry runs both steps again; the account gets a new password.
monitoring.hubs.radio_follow_hint: The Client runs another radio mode than the Server. The Server sends it its own mode; a Client without the RAK5146 card refuses LoRaWAN and Dual.
monitoring.hubs.client_gateway_unregiste: The Client's gateway is not granted on the Server – the Server drops its data.
monitoring.hubs.client_gateway_mismatch: The Client's gateway ({reported}) differs from the one granted on the Server ({registered}) – the Server drops its data.
monitoring.hubs.retry_confirm: Registering again issues a new password; the Client's current one stops working. Continue?
monitoring.hubs.registered_waiting: registered — waiting for the Client to connect
monitoring.hubs.cluster_server_desc: Client Hubs registered with this Server. A Client is managed from here once it has joined and is paired.
monitoring.hubs.client_never_connected: Registered — this Client has not connected to the Server yet. Its unit and system settings are available after its first connection.
monitoring.hubs.remove_desc: Ends the Client's broker account and its sessions and deregisters its gateway. This portal's pairing with it is removed too.
monitoring.hubs.remove_consequence_accou: The Client can no longer connect to this Server; its forwarded traffic stops.
monitoring.hubs.remove_consequence_nodes: Nodes heard through this Client lose its coverage but stay registered.
monitoring.hubs.remove_consequence_keys: Its pairing keys and its registry row are removed from this portal.
monitoring.hubs.remove_not_client: This Hub is not a registered Client. The Server is never removed; a factory reset is its only way out.
monitoring.hubs.remove_incomplete: Removal incomplete; the Client stays listed. Remove it again to retry.
monitoring.hubs.sb_fw_desc: The Southbridge drives sensor power and the line LEDs. At start the Hub flashes it with the firmware in its image when they differ.
monitoring.hubs.sb_update_already_runnin: A Southbridge firmware update is already running.
monitoring.hubs.sb_update_done_ok: The Southbridge firmware is updated: it runs {version}.
monitoring.hubs.sb_update_done_unconfirm: The Hub did not confirm the update; the Southbridge runs {version}.
monitoring.hubs.sb_update_force_hint: Flash even when the Southbridge already runs the version in the Hub image.
monitoring.hubs.sb_update_unavailable: This Hub reports no Southbridge firmware in its image, or its agent cannot update it from the portal.
monitoring.hubs.sb_update_warning: The Hub flashes the Southbridge with the firmware in the Hub image. For about 15 seconds the sensors are unpowered and the line LEDs are off.
monitoring.meta.backfill_auto_hint: Manual downloads always run, whatever this is set to.
monitoring.meta.err_save_failed: The metadata could not be saved.
monitoring.meta.set_on_hub: Set when the device is registered on the Hub.
monitoring.meta.err_name_too_long: The name can be at most 64 characters.
monitoring.meta.err_description_too_long: The description can be at most 255 characters.
monitoring.meta.heading: Device metadata
monitoring.meta.offline_k_hint: Blank uses the system setting; 0 turns offline detection off for this device.
monitoring.node_detail.carrier_off: This Node's radio ({carrier}) is off on this Hub.
monitoring.node_detail.carrier_off_help: The Node stays registered and keeps its history. Commands do not reach it until the Hub turns the radio back on, or the Node is moved to a radio the Hub has on.
monitoring.node_detail.config_boot_only_: The settings the Node reports by itself after every boot. The rest of its configuration (LoRaWAN, alarm slots, other keys) is not shown: the Portal would not know if it changed over the shell or NFC.
monitoring.node_detail.config_help_inter: How often the Node sends its measurements.
How often the Node measures between reports. 0 = measure only when reporting.
monitoring.node_detail.config_keys_unrea: The device did not return these keys, so they could not be read: {keys}
monitoring.node_detail.config_not_editab: Only the report and sample intervals are edited here. Other keys go through the service card's raw message.
monitoring.node_detail.dev_status_none: Not queried yet. The Node answers after its next uplink.
monitoring.node_detail.err_move_confirm_: That is not this Node's DevEUI. The radio was not changed.
monitoring.node_detail.err_move_same_car: The Node is already on {carrier}. The radio was not changed.
monitoring.node_detail.err_move_target: Choose LoRaWAN or LoRa P2P. The radio was not changed.
monitoring.node_detail.last_alarm_none: No alarm message has arrived from this Node.
monitoring.node_detail.last_fault_help: The Node's record of its last crash (a fatal firmware error). The Node sends it once, on the first boot after the crash; the Portal keeps it.
monitoring.node_detail.messages_intro: The last up to 10 messages per port (2 telemetry, 3 alarms, 85 commands and configuration), as they arrived — {n} here.
monitoring.node_detail.move_body: The Hub moves the Node from {from} to {to}. Its registration, key, history and Portal settings stay.
monitoring.node_detail.move_confirm_prom: Type {key} to confirm the radio change.
monitoring.node_detail.move_node_warning: The Hub does not switch the Node itself. Switch it too, by NFC or with the shell command radio-mode, or it will not reach the Hub.
monitoring.node_detail.move_target_off: {carrier} is switched off on this Hub. The Hub takes the Node when {carrier} is switched on.
monitoring.node_detail.moved_ok: The Node is now on {carrier}. Switch the Node itself too (NFC or shell radio-mode), or it will not reach the Hub.
monitoring.node_detail.no_config_yet: No configuration read from this Node yet.
monitoring.node_detail.sensors_unknown: The Node has not sent its config info yet, so its sensors are not known.
monitoring.node_detail.value_hint: sent as text — the server validates the type for this key
monitoring.pending.alarm_table_too_many: Not sent: more channels have critical bounds than the Node has alarm slots (16), and the alarm table is replaced whole. Remove the critical bounds of: {fields}.
monitoring.pending.alarm_table_unknown_t: Not sent: the Node has no sensor type configured for the 1-Wire slot of {fields}, so its rule would be inert and replacing the alarm table would drop it. Set the slot's sensor type on the Node (Manager app or w1 teach), or remove the critical bounds of these fields.
monitoring.pending.firmware_too_old: Not sent: {keys} needs Node firmware 2.0.0 or newer, and this Node runs {version}.
monitoring.pending.send_refused_title: Send is blocked until the problem above is fixed.
monitoring.sensor_switch.confirm_delete: The channel's whole history, its limits and its alarms will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
monitoring.sensor_switch.confirm_device: The device keeps sending the value; the Portal shows only the last one.
monitoring.sensor_switch.confirm_send: The Node holds this channel's limit too. A new alarm table is drafted and the Send configuration bar appears.
monitoring.sensor_switch.disabled: Channel {sensor} is off and its data are deleted.
monitoring.sensor_switch.disabled_send: Channel {sensor} is off and its data are deleted. The limit's removal goes out with Send configuration.
monitoring.sensor_switch.enabled: Channel {sensor} is on. It is stored from the next message.
monitoring.sensor_switch.err_failed: The channel could not be switched; nothing changed.
monitoring.sensor_switch.err_hub: The Hub did not remove the channel's limit, the channel stays on: {message}
monitoring.sensor_switch.err_off: The channel is switched off and takes no limits. Switch it on first.
monitoring.sensor_switch.hint_off: Once switched on, values are stored from the next message, with no history and no limits.
monitoring.sensor_switch.hint_on: A switched-off channel is not stored, has no limits or alarms and is not shown in monitoring or charts. Switching it off deletes its history.
monitoring.sensor_switch.label: Channel on
monitoring.node_keys.reveal_audited_note: This reveal was recorded in the audit log. The values are the ones the Hub published for this Node's session; a value it did not publish stays empty.
monitoring.node_status_bit.alarm_any_hel: At least one alarm is latched on the Node.
monitoring.node_status_bit.alarm_no_data: The no-data watchdog latched: a sensor stopped delivering values.
monitoring.node_status_bit.alarm_state_h: A discrete state rule is active.
monitoring.node_status_bit.alarm_thresho: An analog threshold rule is active.
monitoring.node_status_bit.claim_active_: The Node can still be claimed; the bit clears once it is claimed.
monitoring.node_status_bit.history_down_: The history flash failed to mount; readings are not kept on the Node.
monitoring.node_status_bit.i2c_wedged_he: The I²C bus failed repeatedly; onboard sensors may not answer.
monitoring.node_status_bit.lrw_disabled_: The DevEUI is all zeros, so the Node does not transmit.
monitoring.node_status_bit.mailbox_down_: The NFC chip's mailbox is not authorised; configuration over NFC does not work.
monitoring.node_status_bit.nfc_down_help: The NFC chip (ST25DV) failed to start; the Node runs without it.
monitoring.node_status_bit.radio_link_do: The Node's radio link is not healthy.
monitoring.node_status_bit.radio_off_hel: The radio mode is off: the Node is silent on purpose.
monitoring.node_status_bit.time_unsynced: The Node has no wall-clock time yet.
monitoring.nodes.app_key_hint: 32 hexadecimal characters. The key is passed straight to the Hub — the portal never stores it and never writes it to the audit log.
monitoring.nodes.empty_body: {hostname} has not reported any Nodes. Nodes appear here automatically after their first uplink.
monitoring.nodes.err_add_failed: The Node could not be registered.
monitoring.nodes.err_address_collision: Cannot add {dev_eui} as a P2P node: its radio address {addr} (the last 8 hex digits of the DevEUI) is already used by {holder_dev_eui} on this Hub. P2P nodes are addressed on air by the last 32 bits of the DevEUI only, so two nodes with the same ending cannot share a Hub. Use LoRaWAN for one of them or move it to another Hub.
monitoring.nodes.err_already_exists: This DevEUI is already registered on the Hub. Nothing was sent.
monitoring.nodes.err_hub_not_server: Nodes are registered on the Server {server} only, not on {hub}. A Client Hub does not register Nodes.
monitoring.nodes.err_invalid_app_key: The AppKey has to be exactly 32 hexadecimal characters.
monitoring.nodes.err_invalid_dev_eui: The DevEUI has to be exactly 16 hexadecimal characters.
monitoring.nodes.err_invalid_join_eui: The JoinEUI has to be blank or exactly 16 hexadecimal characters.
monitoring.nodes.err_invalid_radio: Choose LoRaWAN or LoRa P2P. Nothing was sent.
monitoring.nodes.err_invalid_serial: Type the serial number in decimal (2162165722) or as 8 hexadecimal characters (80e007da); it must fit in 32 bits.
monitoring.nodes.err_no_server: The portal cannot find the Server Nodes are registered on. Check that the Server is connected.
monitoring.nodes.err_radio_off: {carrier} is switched off on this Hub, so a Node cannot be registered on it. Nothing was sent.
monitoring.nodes.err_registered_on_carri: This DevEUI is already registered on {carrier}. A Node is registered on one radio only; change its radio on its page (Change radio). Nothing was sent.
monitoring.nodes.err_remove_confirm_mism: That is not this Node's key. Nothing was removed.
monitoring.nodes.err_remove_failed: The Node could not be removed.
monitoring.nodes.fault_missing_measureme: A channel reports an alarm state but no value
monitoring.nodes.join_eui_hint: Optional, 16 hexadecimal characters. Prefilled with the Hub default; leave it blank to use the Hub default.
monitoring.nodes.no_device_body: No Hub has reported in yet, so there are no Nodes to show.
monitoring.nodes.radio_off_hint: {carrier} is switched off on this Hub.
monitoring.nodes.registered_ok: The Node is registered and is now waiting for its first join.
monitoring.nodes.remove_body: The Node is deprovisioned from the Hub, and its description, overrides and unsent configuration are deleted with it. Its recorded history stays.
monitoring.nodes.search_title: Searches by SN, name, label and DevEUI
monitoring.nodes.serial_hint: From the device label, in decimal (2162165722) or hex (80e007da).
monitoring.pending.alarm_layout_moved: The Node's active sensors changed and moved its alarm slots. The alarm table is drafted for sending.
monitoring.pending.banner_body: These changes are saved in the portal but have not reached the device yet. Review them and send when you are ready.
monitoring.pending.device_did_not_confir: {key}: the device did not accept it within {seconds} s. The rest of the draft was not sent.
monitoring.pending.discard_confirm: Discard every unsent change for this Node?
monitoring.pending.err_draft_failed: The change could not be saved to the draft.
monitoring.pending.nothing_changed: No bound changed, so the draft stays as it was.
monitoring.pending.restart_note: The Node saves the new configuration and restarts.
monitoring.pending.saved_to_draft: Saved to the draft. Nothing has been sent to the device yet.
monitoring.pending.send_complete: Configuration sent and accepted by the device ({count} of them).
monitoring.pending.send_in_progress: This Node's configuration is already being sent. Wait for it to finish.
monitoring.pending.send_interrupted: The send was interrupted before the device accepted this key. Send again.
monitoring.pending.send_started: Sending the configuration. The banner above follows it key by key.
monitoring.pending.superseded: {key}: the draft changed while it was being sent, so the rest was not sent.
monitoring.pending.unreadable: {key}: the stored value cannot be read, so nothing was sent. Retype it.
monitoring.pending.waiting_for_uplink: The Node takes the change within its next two uplinks; the portal waits for its answer up to {minutes} min.
monitoring.probe_detail.event_delete_con: Delete this event? A correction is a delete plus a new entry — there is no edit.
monitoring.probe_detail.events_truncated: This sensor has more events than one window can list; the oldest part of the range is missing.
monitoring.probe_detail.events_unreadabl: Part of the event list could not be read — this timeline is incomplete.
monitoring.probe_detail.no_data: No stored readings in this range.
monitoring.probe_detail.no_operational: Liveness of a wired probe is the Hub's, not the probe's — only the Hub reports being offline, so this probe has no offline/online events of its own.
monitoring.probe_detail.outage_spans_ran: The sensor was already offline when this range began.
monitoring.probe_detail.title: Sensor detail
monitoring.probe_detail.unknown_probe: This sensor is no longer reported by any Hub.
monitoring.service.admin_only_note: Admins only. Every action here is recorded in the audit log, including the two reads — each of them wakes the device and costs it airtime.
monitoring.service.hub_unpaired: Not available while the Hub is not paired.
monitoring.service.locked_banner: Locked. Unlock to use the functions below; the card locks again after 5 minutes or when you leave the page.
monitoring.service.restart_node_help: The Node restarts once the command reaches it, with its next uplink.
monitoring.service.send_msg_help: One set-config message straight to the Node, without a draft.
monitoring.service.unlocked_banner: Unlocked. Actions run on the device; the card locks again in 5 minutes.
monitoring.service.force_send_help: The Node sends an extra measurement once the command reaches it, within its next two uplinks. It does not answer on the command port; the measurement is the confirmation.
monitoring.service.force_send_no_respons: No response: no measurement arrived by {until}.
monitoring.service.force_send_waiting: Sent {sent}; waiting for the Node's measurement until {until}.
monitoring.service.payload_hint: One JSON object of set-config key/value pairs. It is sent at once, without a draft.
monitoring.service.raw_key_refused: Not sent through a raw message: {keys}. The alarm slots come from the thresholds; history_sensors, sensor ROMs, the LoRaWAN group and vendor_reset_allow are set over NFC.
monitoring.service.reboot_confirm_mismat: That is not this Node's key. Nothing was sent.
monitoring.service.send_msg_not_json: The message has to be a non-empty JSON object, for example {"application.history_enable": true}.
monitoring.service.send_msg_warning: Sent at once, without a draft; the Node saves it and restarts. control-radio checks keys, types and ranges against the firmware registry, and the Node refuses what its firmware does not accept.
monitoring.shared.battery_not_thresholda: The battery takes no threshold: the Node raises its own low-battery alarm.
monitoring.shared.bound_must_be_number: {field} must be a number or blank
monitoring.shared.bounds_out_of_order: Bounds must rise: critical low < warning low ≤ warning high < critical high.
monitoring.shared.count_must_be_number: {field} must be a whole number of 0 or more, or blank
monitoring.shared.count_out_of_range: {field} must be a whole number between 0 and {max}, or blank
monitoring.shared.dev_status_queued: Device status requested. The Node answers after its next uplink.
monitoring.shared.device_read_queued: Device info and config info requested. The Node answers within its next two uplinks.
monitoring.shared.field_not_active: {field}: this Node does not measure this channel (per its config info), so it takes no bounds
monitoring.shared.info_request_queued: Device info requested; it arrives within the device's next two reports.
monitoring.shared.name_hint_serial_fallb: Optional. Left blank, the device registers under its serial number.
monitoring.shared.no_device_yet: No device has reported in yet.
monitoring.shared.config_refresh_queued: Config read requested; the values arrive within the device's next two reports.
monitoring.shared.config_send_queued: Configuration queued for the Node. Within its next two uplinks the Node takes it, saves it, restarts and reports the new values.
monitoring.shared.reboot_queued: Reboot queued; the Node restarts once the command reaches it, within its next two uplinks, then reports again.
monitoring.shared.signing_key_failed: Failed to prepare a signing key for this command.
monitoring.shared.signing_key_not_paired: The Hub is not paired, so the command cannot be signed. Pair the Hub on its System tab and try again.
monitoring.shared.unknown_node: This Node is not registered on the Hub; nothing was saved.
monitoring.threshold.hint_base: Leave a limit blank to unset it.
monitoring.threshold.hysteresis_hint: An alarm ends once the value is back inside the limit by the hysteresis. One value for all four limits, 0 = off.
monitoring.threshold.hysteresis_invalid: The hysteresis must be a number ≥ 0.
monitoring.threshold.warnings_saved: Saved. Warning bounds apply at once: the portal grades them, they are not sent to the device.
monitoring.threshold.warnings_saved_crit: Warning bounds apply at once. The critical bounds wait in the draft; nothing has been sent to the device yet.
monitoring.threshold.hysteresis_too_wide: The hysteresis must be smaller than the narrowest gap between two neighbouring limits ({gap}).
monitoring.threshold.hint_critical_range: A critical band is always a range, so the Node can watch it too. A side at its extreme (−99 / +199) means no bound on that side. Clear both fields to remove the critical band.
monitoring.threshold.hint_off: Off: nothing is evaluated or sent until Threshold enabled is ticked.
monitoring.threshold.saved_off: Saved. The threshold is off, so nothing was sent.
monitoring.threshold_form.err_all_four: All four limits are required for a wired probe. Fill in the critical and warning low and high limits.
monitoring.threshold_form.hint: All four limits are required. Values in °C.
monitoring.node_param_help.application.i: How often the Node measures, in seconds. 0 measures just before each report.
How often the Node sends its readings, in seconds.
monitoring.node_param_help.application.h: The Node keeps its measurements in its memory, for the Portal to download after a lost connection.
monitoring.node_param_help.application.b: Low-battery alarm threshold in mV. Below it the Node raises a battery alarm.
monitoring.node_param_help.sensors.cap_g: What the GP pins drive: none, inputs (A/B), PIR motion detector or buzzer.
Input A mode (GP pins in inputs): none, digital, analog (voltage) or pulse (counter).
Input B mode (GP pins in inputs): none, digital, analog (voltage) or pulse (counter).
monitoring.node_param_help.sensors.cap_b: Buzzer fitted. Shares pins with the PIR detector; when both are on, the PIR wins.
monitoring.node_param_help.sensors.cap_w: 1-Wire bus on; the Node finds the attached probes by itself.
monitoring.node_param_help.sensors.cap_a: Accelerometer: orientation, motion and free fall.
monitoring.node_param_help.sensors.accel: Motion detection sensitivity of the accelerometer.
monitoring.node_param_help.sensors.hall_: Count the pulses of the left Hall sensor.
Count the pulses of the right Hall sensor.
monitoring.node_param_help.sensors.input: Count the pulses on input A.
Count the pulses on input B.
monitoring.node_param_help.alarms.alarm_: Shortest gap between two alarm messages, in seconds. 0 = no limit.
How the buzzer signals an alarm: once, repeated every 120/30/10 s (slow/normal/fast) or continuously. Needs the buzzer.
monitoring.node_param_help.alarms.radio_: Alarm messages wait for the network's acknowledgement and are sent again up to 3 times. Off by default: alarms go once, unconfirmed, on either radio.
monitoring.node_param_help.application.i: How often (hours) the Node re-sends its start-up report and settings, without a restart or a new join. 0 = off.
monitoring.node_param_help.sensors.cap_s: The onboard temperature and humidity sensor (SHT4x).
monitoring.node_param_help.sensors.senso: The configured sensor type of 1-Wire slot 1 (0 = none). The Node derives it from the attached sensor at start-up.
The configured sensor type of 1-Wire slot 2 (0 = none). The Node derives it from the attached sensor at start-up.
The configured sensor type of 1-Wire slot 3 (0 = none). The Node derives it from the attached sensor at start-up.
The configured sensor type of 1-Wire slot 4 (0 = none). The Node derives it from the attached sensor at start-up.
monitoring.pending.undelivered_bound: The bound applies (evaluated from telemetry); not delivered to the Node yet — Send again
monitoring.pending.hub_set_node_pending: Bound set on the Hub, waiting for the Node to confirm
monitoring.pending.undelivered_note: The bounds already apply on the Hub and in the portal and are evaluated from telemetry. The Node does not have them yet: Send again sends only its part, Discard puts the Hub and the portal back to the values from before the send. Nothing goes back on its own.
monitoring.pending.bound_applied_node_un: {key}: the bound applies (evaluated from telemetry); not delivered to the Node yet — send again.
monitoring.pending.discard_revert_failed: Discard failed: the Hub did not take the previous bound back ({reason}). The draft is unchanged; try again.
monitoring.pending.discard_revert_invali: Cannot discard: the band of {field} from before the send is out of order ({reason}). Fix the bounds and send them, or edit the draft.
monitoring.threshold_table.on_node_unkno: unknown — the Node may have taken the change
monitoring.threshold_table.on_node_diffe: no — the Node holds another band (a discarded change)
monitoring.threshold_table.node_unsynced: Not synchronised with the Node (the Node has {band})
Limits are not synchronised with the Node
The Portal grades by the stored limits. After a discarded message the Node holds other critical bounds and sends early by them.
monitoring.threshold_table.node_resync_n: All limits are synchronised with the Node.
monitoring.pending.node_differs_note: The Node applied a discarded change and holds other bounds than the Hub and the portal. The portal drafted its own bounds again; send them.
monitoring.calibration.open_hint: Click a row for the certificate, upload and history.
monitoring.command_status.delivered: Saved in the Portal and delivered to the Hub
monitoring.command_status.pending: Saved; critical limits await Node sync
monitoring.limits.bound_pending: Awaiting sync with the Node; the Node still holds {value} until it confirms
monitoring.pending.saved_sending: Saved. The Portal grades with it at once; the settings are being sent to the Node and wait for its confirmation.
monitoring.pending.awaiting_body: These parameters are being set on the Node as one message. The Portal already grades with them; the Node takes them at its next transmission and confirms them.
monitoring.pending.deadline_passed: The Node did not confirm within 4 h of sending ({time}). A fault is open; send the settings again.
monitoring.hub_sensor.intervals_intro: These apply to every line of the Hub, not just this probe.
monitoring.device_info.heading: Device information
monitoring.device_info.name: Name
monitoring.channels.heading: Channels
monitoring.channels.confirm_stays: The channel stays in this table as off.
monitoring.device_config.heading: Device configuration
monitoring.device_config.interval_sample: How often the device measures and evaluates limits, in seconds.
monitoring.device_config.interval_report: How often the device sends its current values, in seconds.
How often the Beacon's current values are stored, in seconds. Cluster-wide, the same for every Beacon (the Hub's aggregation interval); per-Beacon setting: issue #141.
monitoring.device_config.interval_sample: How often the Hub measures the wired probes and evaluates limits, in seconds. Cluster-wide, read-only; per-probe setting: issue #142.
monitoring.device_config.interval_report: How often the probes' current values are stored, in seconds. Cluster-wide, read-only; per-probe setting: issue #142.
monitoring.device_config.offline_k_help: Missed reports before the device is marked offline. 0 turns detection off; blank uses the global default.
monitoring.device_config.offline_k_help_: Failed readings in a row before the probe is marked disconnected (default 3). Cluster-wide, read-only; see issue #142.
monitoring.device_config.history_help_no: After an outage the missing history is downloaded automatically. The Node stores history while it cannot send.
monitoring.device_config.history_help_be: After an outage the missing history is downloaded automatically from the Beacon's own archive.
monitoring.device_config.saved_sending: Saved; sending to the Node, waiting for it to confirm.
monitoring.device_config.err_offline_k: Offline detection must be a whole number, 0 or more, or blank.
monitoring.hubs.nb_fw_desc: The firmware the Northbridge (LoRa P2P radio) runs, against the image this Hub bundles.
monitoring.hubs.nb_fw_not_reported: The Hub has not reported Northbridge firmware updates; only the running version is known.
monitoring.device.pairing_steps_heading: How to open pairing mode on the Hub's display:
monitoring.device.pairing_step_button: Hold the Hub's top button for about 2 s until the menu opens on the display.
monitoring.device.pairing_step_menu: Select “Pairing mode” in the menu and confirm.
monitoring.device.pairing_step_portal: Start pairing in the portal again.
monitoring.hubs.remove_consequence_reset: The Hub returns to factory settings (its Client role and access to this Server are erased), so it can be added elsewhere.
monitoring.hubs.remove_hostname_mismatch: The hostname does not match; nothing was removed.
